about_the_game:
Earth is threatened by an alien force and bombarded with asteroids. You are the last hope to save the earth. Will you accept the challenge?

Defend Earth against alien asteroid attacks in this arcade shooter and experience the evolution of the genre in a gripping visual and auditory adventure.

Fight, Defend, Fail, Upgrade, Repeat and Strike Back.

The Game is a classic arcade space shooter with roguelike elements.

After your ship is destroyed, you can permanently upgrade it, provided you have collected enough alien tech. With each upgrade, the visuals evolve too – from 2-bit black and white, through retro styles, all the way to modern graphics – letting you relive the history of shooter visuals.

In this Demo you can play the first 4 Waves and upgrade you ship once.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU (Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon 64 X2 or better)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics or equivalent, DirectX 9.0c support)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard sound
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most modern laptops and desktops
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU optional (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or modern
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard sound
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: Smooth gameplay on most systems
